title: Kremich Surge
description: Watch results for the Kremich Surge — a reach of wrecker clans, crimson banners, and hungry rifts.

prompts.text: The waves surge, but the sound is soothing.
Branches rake the hull, insects spiral into the air.
Distant chants echo from passing ships, mournful and haunting.
A series of poles rise from the thrash, hung with scarlet ribbons trailing in the wind.
You pass an ancient wreck wreathed in vines and long picked clean.
Reefs here are carved with leering faces and ancient prayers.
A skiff of wreckers pulls alongside, offering salvage and stories for trade.
A trade ship travelling between colonies with supplies, suspicious of outsiders.
A priest stands on a small outcropping of stone, exhorting loudly.
Several wrecker clans bicker over a newly emerged reef.
An encounter with a red-bannered ship crewed by voracious cannibals.
A ship crewed by Crossed Out marauders howls across the waves.
A wreck surfaces from the thrash just ahead of the ship, its deck littered with bones.
A rootquake drives the waves into chaos.
Something vast travels beneath the ship, leaving the waves heaving in its wake.
A sudden storm descends on the ship, almost seeming alive in its fury.
The crushing scrutiny of That Which Hungers bears down on the ship.
A Hungering Rift opens in the waves, sucking down everything it can.
